description: This file defines the lease strategy implementation for Kubernetes, including validation, preparation, and update logic for Lease objects within the coordination package.

classes.name: leaseStrategy
classes.description: Implements verification logic for Lease objects, including validation and preparation methods.

methods.name: NamespaceScoped
methods.description: Returns true indicating Lease objects are namespace scoped.

methods.name: PrepareForCreate
methods.description: Prepares a Lease object for creation, resetting certain fields based on feature gate.

methods.name: PrepareForUpdate
methods.description: Prepares a Lease object for update, clearing fields not allowed to be set by users.

methods.name: WarningsOnCreate
methods.description: Returns warnings when creating a Lease object (none in this implementation).

methods.name: Canonicalize
methods.description: Normalizes the object after validation (no operation).

methods.name: AllowCreateOnUpdate
methods.description: Indicates that creating a Lease with PUT is allowed.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update to a Lease object.

methods.name: WarningsOnUpdate
methods.description: Returns warnings when updating a Lease object (none in this implementation).

methods.name: AllowUnconditionalUpdate
methods.description: Indicates whether unconditional updates are allowed for Lease objects.
